:::{#exm-complement-set-difference}
#### A complement as a set difference

For the fair die in @exm-sample-space,
the [sample space](#def-sample-space) is $\samplespace = \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$.
For the [event](#def-event) $A = \set{2, 4, 6}$ in @exm-event,
the [set difference](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/sets.html#def-set-difference) is $\setdiff{\samplespace}{A} = \set{1, 3, 5}$,
which is the [complement](#def-complement) $\neg A$ in @exm-complement.

<!-- no-figure: a six-element set difference; nothing to plot -->

:::
